scopes.name: read_additional_organization_data
scopes.description: Grants read access to additional organizational information about a partner representing a company. The additional data contains legal form, industry, local court, stakeholders and tax identification.

scopes.name: verify_account_ownership
scopes.description: Performs account verification for the given customer.

scopes.name: read_partners_legi
scopes.description: Grants read access to legitimation data of the current partner/customer. This data is only available for natural persons. Legitimation data contains information, e.g. about the document type, document number and document issue date for the given customer.

scopes.name: read_check_information
scopes.description: Know-Your-Customer Information

scopes.name: read_legal_representatives_data
scopes.description: Information about legal representatives

scopes.name: read_customer_data
scopes.description: Performs personal data verification for the given customer.

scopes.name: read_partners
scopes.description: Grants read access to basic data of the current partner/customer. The basic partner data contains, among other information, the first name, the surname and the birthdate for the given customer. There is some overlap between our /partners endpoint and the /userinfo endpoint provided by OpenID connect.

scopes.name: read_additional_personal_data
scopes.description: Grants read access to additional data about the partner. The additional data currently contains the tax identifications for the given customer.

scopes.name: read_addresses
scopes.description: Grants read access to address data for the given customer. Two address types are currently supported: business address and private address.

scopes.name: age_certificate
scopes.description: Grants a check of a person's age, when compared against a specific minimum age

scopes.name: reserve_branch_customer_number
scopes.description: Reserve Branch Customer Number

scopes.name: read_brand
scopes.description: Grants permission to get data from the /brand endpoint. Only available with client credential grant flow right now.

scopes.name: create_processing_orders
scopes.description: Grants permission to post data with the /processingOrders endpoint. Only available with client credential grant flow right now.
